verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a payments-infrastructure product, but the evidence only describes BVNK as a hosted service reached through its portal or API. Nothing documents a deployable or self-hostable version of the core platform. The client-side webhook signature validator and the agent-wallet CLI are auxiliary tools, not a self-hosted core product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
